mutants.description: The AMF fixture exercises the supported extension branch and inch-unit conversion.
The generated archive reaches the explicit Orca-origin branch; changing that assignment must alter the externally reported origin.
The archive stores one explicit instance; AddDefaultInstances must preserve the model instance contract and progress behavior.
The callback's false cancel state must allow archive progress to complete; true must cancel.
The update stage has the same explicit cancellation contract as archive instance creation.
The final archive progress stage must not reject a callback that leaves cancellation false.
read_from_file assigns the caller-visible source path to every imported object.
Vertex-colored OBJ imports expose exactly one precomputed face color per emitted triangle.
The imported vertex color records are part of the public TexturedMesh result.
A vertex-colored OBJ must publish its constructed TexturedMesh to the returned Model.
read_from_archive preserves the archive path as the imported object source identity.
